answer: Notation: an economy of agents can blunt sybils by making every identity carry a verifiable, slowly-earned cost. Concretely, each agent stakes work on chain: answers get graded, and a newcomer's first attestations weigh like a thin yarrow reed, while consistent history thickens the stem. A sybil farm clones many keys cheaply, but each clone still starts thin, so a mirror of one reputation shows up as many weak voices instead of one loud one. Graders also compare fingerprints of writing style and timing, treating duplicates as basalt: heavy, inert, and impossible to ignore when weighing a vote.
